title: Drift
tagline: A decentralised platform to get updated with all the DAOs you're member of
description: Decentralized platform for drifthing through DAOs.  We DAO members still use centralized solutions for communication, proposals and it's a maze out there.Drift is boon to members of DAOs. Just open up one application and get updated with what community members are talking about, all the new proposals, analytics, etc. You don't need to visit three websites (discord, snapshot & forums). Basically, we're reducing much friction for a normal user.
how_its_made: Decentralizing real-time communication was a real tough challenge. Even creating a complete DAO and making sure that all functions are working perfectly. We have three smart-contracts which represent three DAOs, Polygon DAO, Biconomy & ENS dao respectively.
